messages:
zoe: Heads-up — python SDK samplekit failing: JSON mode + fncall. When a tool triggers a retry the JSON payload becomes doubly-escaped and schema validator rejects it.

ashok: repro available?

zoe: minimal repro:
```
# request
client.chat.completions.create(..., json_mode=True, functions=[...])
# tool response (ok)
{"result": {"user": "alice", "score": 0.7}}
# after retry log observed by SDK
response_text = "\"{\"result\": {\"user\": \"alice\", \"score\": 0.7}}\""
```

carmen: oof. which py sdk version?

zoe: 0.10.2 (from samplekit template). Node repros differently — node returns raw object, python shows string.

sam: my hunch: retry wrapper is `json.dumps`-ing already-dumped tool outputs. Possibly inside `helpers/retry.py` we run `json.dumps(resp_text)` before re-raising. I'll grep.

sam: quick grep shows:`
```
# pseudo
if should_retry:
    body = json.dumps(body)
    raise RetryLater(body=body)
```

ashok: can we add a sanity parse step before retry? like `try: json.loads(body)` then don't re-dump.

carmen: good idea. also add a unit that simulates tool returning str vs dict.

zoe: I can add failing test to `samplekit/tests/test_fncall_jsonmode.py` and link it in the bug. CI shows it only on python wheel.

dev-bot: CI job 4521 failed on `py-0.10.2` — linked: https://ci/redwood/4521

sam: i'll draft fix: check isinstance(body, str) and attempt json.loads; if loads succeeds, keep as object. push patch to `fix/retry-jsonmode-escape` and add test.

ashok: can we ship a hotfix to 0.10.x? security is fine but this breaks onboarding demos.

sam: will backport to 0.10.x after review. ETA EOD tomorrow. adding TODO: update changelog + release note: 'fix: avoid double-escaping JSON mode fncall retries'

carmen: Also flag for devex: update samplekit template to pin to patched minor until release.

zoe: thanks! leaving repro + logs in bug: #INF-2391 :thumbsup:

sam: assigning to me. @ashok please add review when ready.
